value.value: @concat('There were errors encountered when loading ',variables('FileName'),' from <',variables('ImportPath',variables('QuarantinePath'),'> as ',variables('QuarantineFileName'),' and the members will not be loaded to the dialer for the next creation of the call list.')

@concat('NoMemberMatch_',replace(variables('FileName'),'.','_'),'_',formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'yyyy'),notConvertedectfunctionstringright(concat('0',formatDateTime(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'), 'MM')), 2),notConvertedectfunctionstringright(concat('0',dayOfMonth(formatDateTime(utcnow(),'M/d/yyyy hh:mm:ss tt'))), 2),'.csv')
